facts.business: Picturehouse Media Limited operates in the Media and Entertainment industry, focusing on content creation and related opportunities.

auditor.name: RPSV & CO, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to material weakness in internal financial controls regarding assessment of carrying value of loans and advances and inventory (notes 43 and 44), and need to strengthen documentation for loan disbursements. Also includes Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern
Weak internal financial controls over valuation of loans, advances and inventory
Ongoing legal cases including SEBI penalty order for insider trading involving fellow subsidiary PVP Global Ventures Private Limited
Company has no employees in administration; operations carried out by holding company employees
Inadequate systems and processes to monitor compliance with applicable laws
facts.related_party_note: Fellow subsidiary PVP Global Ventures Private Limited provided the Company's land parcel (53 acres 30 guntas) as security deposit to SEBI in a legal case against SEBI's penalty order for insider trading. The Securities Appellate Tribunal confirmed a penalty of Rs.15 Crores on PVP Global Ventures Private Limited. Supreme Court directed SEBI to release attached properties on furnishing bank guarantee of Rs.16.50 crores.
